{"notes": "VISIT 1 (3:30-4:15). I don't know who placed which domino, so these are provisional.

MAYA: Self-directed lead. She spoke at all three of my checks and gave a clear status: bottom body and tail done, top body stuck at the junction. Her description matches the table, since the dark chain runs from the start along the bottom. But she has said essentially the same thing for 45 minutes: she is 'looking closely', her join didn't fit, and now she'll re-lay the whole line. She kept telling Leo and Tom to stay off the crowded corner, which sidelines two teammates while the main blocker is unresolved. The junction is still a tangle of pale, disconnected pieces. Good: she is candid about failures and has a plan. Concern: a bottleneck on one corner, plenty of talk, and unclear output. Ask next time what she has actually placed and whether Leo and Tom have useful work.

TOM: Said nothing while I was there. Maya says he is checking the nose. His hands are at the top left, on a pale (unconnected) chain that starts near the end of the dark line. It looks almost connected, so it could be a quick fix. Several other pale loops on the left are also not connected. Need to see what he is contributing.

PRIYA: Silent. Her hands are on the dark connected chain at the bottom right, so she may be solid on the body. No other evidence yet. Check in with her directly and ask privately.

LEO: Maya says he is on the back edge, but his hands are at the lower middle on a pale, unconnected chain. Following Maya's instruction to stay clear. Not enough to rate."}
